evidences.evidence_context: Related work: ... some works use RF signals, such as Wi-Fi[29], mmWave[2], and RFID[3], [4], [30], to capture object vibration for sensing speaker-produced sound[1], [2], [3], [29], [30] or capture body motions for sensing human-speaking sound[4]. However, due to sensor limitations, these methods can sense either speaker-produced or human-speaking sound, but not both simultaneously.
